battle.name: 隋定三吳之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年正月，隋文帝以三路大軍平陳：楊素、楊俊出蜀打通三峽並供應糧道，韓擒虎、賀若弼夜渡采石，攻取姑孰與石頭城，隋軍入建康，陳朝覆亡。卡面亞述長弓代表弓兵開路、車兵隨後的遠程戰法傳統，隋軍正以步弓與強弩為渡江先鋒掩護，弩箭壓制江防，攻城車與糧船隨後而進。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 此役是隋王朝對南朝陳的滅國戰役，發生在開皇九年（589）正月。隋方主體是北周、北齊遺產整合而成的新王朝：文帝楊堅整合北方舊地，控弦之兵號稱百萬，倉廩之積遠勝江南；下詔大發兵後，以晉王楊廣為淮南行省尚書令、總制諸軍，並置軍諫於采石節制水路，高熲為元帥長史、王誼為副元帥，楊素為行軍總管，楊俊為開府儀同三司、總督軍務，韓擒虎為廬州總管，賀若弼為行軍元帥。兵分三路：楊素、楊俊自益州沿長江上游東下，開通三峽與荊州並供應下游糧餉；韓擒虎自廬州沿淮趨江，負責正面突破；賀若弼自廣陵率眾南下策應。江南部分地方豪族與嶺南俚族首領冼夫人站在隋方，冼夫人遣孫冼魂率部眾迎隋軍，嶺南諸州因此不戰而定。陳方是建都建康的南朝陳，後主陳叔寶總攬軍國，以蕭摩訶、任忠、施文慶、樊俊等分守采石、姑孰與建康城，倚長江天險與密集的江防弓弩。陳亡之後，江南豪族如沈恪、汪文進與陳州餘部等起兵反隋，楊素、楊廣、蘇威再行鎮壓，江南復歸一統。
countriesEn: This campaign was the Sui dynasty's war of extinction against the Southern Chen court, fought in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang (589). On the Sui side stood a newly consolidated central state: Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, had taken over the manpower and stores left by the former Northern Zhou and Northern Qi, and the field armies of the empire were said to number in the hundreds of thousands, with granaries far richer than anything the south possessed. After the edict of mass mobilisation in the eighth year of Kaihuang, the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, was appointed Director of the Huainan Office and given overall command of all the armies, with military supervisors posted at Caishi to control the river route; Gao Jiong served as chief of staff of the commander-in-chief, Wang Yi as deputy, Yang Su as director of the marching army, Yang Jun as Grand Master of the Opening Palace and overseer of military affairs, Han Qinhu as governor of Luzhou, and He Ruobi as commander-in-chief of the marching army. The force moved in three columns: Yang Su and Yang Jun came down the upper Yangtze from Yizhou, opening the Three Gorges and Jingzhou and supplying the lower armies with grain and equipment; Han Qinhu advanced from Luzhou along the Huai toward the river to make the frontal breach; He Ruobi marched south from Guangling to support them. Several Jiangnan local powers and the Lingnan chieftain Lady Xian stood on the Sui side, and Lady Xian sent her grandson Xian Hun with his clansmen to welcome the Sui troops, so that most of Lingnan submitted without a battle. The Chen side was the Southern Chen state with its capital at Jiankang, where the last emperor, Chen Shubao, personally directed state and military affairs, with Xiao Mohe, Ren Zhong, Shi Wenqing, Fan Jun and others holding Caishi, Gushu and the capital itself, relying on the natural barrier of the Yangtze and on dense river-line positions for bows and crossbows. After Chen fell, Jiangnan grand families such as Shen Ke, Wang Wenjin and the survivors in Chenzhou rose against the Sui, and were put down by Yang Su, Yang Guang and Su Wei, restoring a single authority over the south.
people: 文帝楊堅是此役的決策者，開皇八年冬下令大發兵，先問計於高熲，採其平陳十策，定下先通荊州、再取建康的方針。晉王楊廣以淮南行省尚書令身分坐鎮揚州總制諸軍，高熲為元帥長史，王誼為副元帥。楊素是全役最吃重的將帥：督造五牙大艦與黃龍艦，備攻城器械，統上游諸軍打通三峽、平定陳荊州刺史歐陽紇，並負責供應下游大軍的糧械。楊俊為開府儀同三司、總督軍務，率眾出蜀，與楊素同線作戰。韓擒虎以廬州總管率主力沿淮入江，夜渡采石，直趨石頭城。賀若弼在廣陵方面指揮，官拜行軍元帥，以精兵先導夜渡采石，天明全軍濟江，率眾直取建康。于仲文別將一軍夜渡白河，擊破陳將邵亮，切斷陳軍側翼。韋衝奉命招撫嶺南，與冼夫人合力掃清陳朝殘部。陳方以蕭摩訶為江防主將，善用長槍；後主陳叔寶屢不納諫議，直到隋軍已渡江才議遷都，危急時與張麗華、孔貴嬪藏入建康景陽殿之井，終被隋軍尋出。任忠等降隋之後仍被誅戮，蕭摩訶亦於亂軍中被擒，陳朝一朝的將佐至此斷絕。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, was the decision maker of the campaign: in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang he ordered mass mobilisation, first taking advice from Gao Jiong and adopting his ten strategies for the conquest of Chen, which set the plan of opening Jingzhou first and then striking Jiankang. The Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, sat at Yangzhou as Director of the Huainan Office to supervise all the armies, with Gao Jiong as chief of staff and Wang Yi as deputy. Yang Su was the heaviest burden of the whole war: he built the five-pronged great ships and the yellow dragon ships, prepared the siege engines, commanded the upper column in breaking through the Three Gorges, forced the surrender of Chen's Jingzhou governor Ouyang He, and then provisioned the downstream armies with grain and materiel. Yang Jun, as Grand Master of the Opening Palace and overseer of military affairs, led troops out of Shu and fought on the same axis. Han Qinhu, as governor of Luzhou, led the main body down the Huai to the river, crossed at Caishi by night and drove straight for the Stone City. He Ruobi, commanding in the Guangling sector with the title of commander-in-chief of the marching army, sent a vanguard across at Caishi by night; at dawn the whole army had crossed and he marched directly on Jiankang. Yu Zhongwen led a separate force across the White River by night, broke Shao Liang, and cut the Chen flank. Wei Chong was sent to pacify Lingnan and, together with Lady Xian, swept up the last Chen forces. On the Chen side Xiao Mohe was the chief commander of the river defence and was famous with the long spear; the last emperor, Chen Shubao, refused his remonstrances again and again and only discussed moving the capital after the Sui army had already crossed the river; in the extremity he hid with Zhang Lihua and Kong Guifei in a well of the Jingyang Hall at Jiankang and was eventually pulled out by Sui soldiers. Ren Zhong and others were killed even after surrendering, and Xiao Mohe was taken prisoner amid the collapse, and with them the officer corps of the Chen state was broken.
kits: 本卡的亞述長弓是亞述帝國晚期的角弓形制，配套的是亞述式的弓兵與車兵組合：弓手上車射擊，車兵依靠弓兵開路，亞述人正是靠弓與鐵的組合打下兩河流域。須說明的是，隋開皇九年（589）的交戰雙方並無亞述式角弓的實戰記載，隋軍真正裝備的是角弓、臂弓與蹶張弩、強弩等弩機，陳軍江防亦以弓弩為主；本卡兵器在此戰中的位置，代表的是「弓兵為步騎開路、遠程火力先行」這一戰法傳統的上游。隋軍的遠程配置是：步弓手與弩手列於前鋒與舟船之上，渡江前以弩箭壓制對岸，掩護持盾的士卒涉水登岸；攻城時以撞車、拍車、巢車近迫城垣，以火箭焚燒城樓與江上陳軍舟船。水軍舟艦是此役的關鍵裝備：楊素督造的五牙大艦上設戰樓，用以撞擊陳軍樓船並居高臨下放箭，黃龍艦則專供運載糧械、接濟上游與下游大軍。糧草多自益州沿長江順流而下，靠糧船與牛馬車隊輸送；陸上另有精騎「玄甲」與護糧車隊作戰。陳軍裝備以長槍、環首刀、盾牌為主，樓船高大但吃水深、靈活遜於五牙大艦，江岸則築有弩台與木柵。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on this card is the angular composite bow of the later Assyrian period, paired with the Assyrian combination of archer and chariot: archers shot from the wagons, and the chariot troops relied on the archers to open the way; it was this pairing of bow and iron that carried the Assyrians through the Mesopotamian river valleys. It should be stated plainly that neither side in the campaign of the ninth year of Kaihuang (589) has any record of Assyrian-style angular bows in action: what the Sui actually carried were ordinary bows and powerful crossbows, including the pedal-drawn crossbow and the strong crossbow, and the Chen defences were likewise built around bows and crossbows. The position of this weapon in the war is therefore that of the ancestor of the tactic of using missile troops to open the way for infantry and cavalry. On the Sui side the missile deployment was as follows: foot archers and crossbowmen were placed at the head of the columns and on the decks of the transports; before crossing, crossbow volleys suppressed the far bank and covered shield-bearing troops wading ashore; at the assault, battering rams, pole-slinging carts and observation towers were brought close against the walls, and fire arrows were used to burn the towers of the city and the Chen warships on the river. Naval equipment was the key to the campaign: the five-pronged great ships built under Yang Su's direction carried fighting platforms, were used to ram Chen tower ships and to shoot down from above, while the yellow dragon ships were devoted to carrying grain and materiel to feed both the upstream and downstream armies. Supplies came mostly down the Yangtze from Yizhou, moved by grain ships and by ox and horse teams; on land the armoured lancers and the escorting baggage trains formed the mobile reserve. The Chen army was equipped principally with long spears, ring-pommel sabres and shields; their tower ships were tall but drew too much water to be as handy as the Sui great ships, and their bank positions were strengthened with bolt emplacements and timber palisades.
tactics: 此役的戰術主軸是三路齊進、上下游策應與奇襲渡江。楊素、楊俊自蜀東下，一方面平陳荊州與歐陽紇部，一方面保障主力由益州順流而下的糧道，使韓擒虎、賀若弼不必分兵顧慮後方；于仲文夜渡白河破邵亮，則是插入陳軍側翼的牽制動作。渡江本身是全役最關鍵的一手：賀若弼於夜裡派先鋒以小船偷渡采石，擊破守軍後天明全軍濟江，掩護部隊繼而強行通過，陳軍以為是小股偷襲，待主力出現已失先機。突破江防之後，隋軍水陸並行，以五牙大艦撞擊陳軍樓船、火箭焚燒江面火炬與帆索，配合弩箭射擊，強行打開通路；登岸即以撞車、拍車、巢車近逼城垣，不與陳軍爭奪野戰決戰，而是直取建康。陳朝的失誤在於防線拉得過長：采石、姑孰與建康之間彼此不能策應，前線一破，京師立陷；朝中將領互不信任，蕭摩訶久不見用，後主又不肯用兵，終致全軍潰散，隋軍得以沿江席捲而無所抵抗。
tacticsEn: The tactical spine of the campaign was the three-column advance, the mutual support of the upper and lower river, and a surprise crossing. Yang Su and Yang Jun coming down from Shu both broke the Chen forces under Ouyang He at Jingzhou and guarded the grain route running down the Yangtze from Yizhou, so that Han Qinhu and He Ruobi never had to detach troops to watch their rear; the night crossing of the White River by Yu Zhongwen to break Shao Liang was a holding movement inserted into the Chen flank. The crossing itself was the decisive stroke: He Ruobi sent a vanguard in small boats across at Caishi in the darkness, broke the garrison, and by dawn the entire army had crossed, the covering parties following in force; the Chen command had taken the move for a raid and lost the initiative only when the main body appeared. Once the river line was broken, Sui forces advanced on land and water together, ramming Chen tower ships with the five-pronged great ships, setting fire to the river's torches and rigging with fire arrows, and covering the advance with crossbow volleys until a lane was forced open; after landing they brought battering rams, pole-slinging carts and observation towers close against the walls, refusing to trade blows in an open-field battle and going straight for Jiankang. Chen's mistake was a defence line stretched too thin: Caishi, Gushu and Jiankang could not support one another, and when the forward positions fell the capital was lost at once; the commanders at court did not trust each other, Xiao Mohe was kept out of employment, and the last emperor would not commit his troops, until the whole force dissolved and the Sui army could sweep up the river with nothing left to oppose it.
data: 可核對的數字有限，以下只列史籍明確記載者。兵力方面，《隋書·高祖紀》記開皇八年冬文帝「大發兵」伐陳，後世常據以稱隋軍出動五十餘萬人；此數顯然包含隨軍役夫、運糧人力與沿途徵發的雜役，實際披甲列陣的戰兵遠少於此，歷來史家多持保留態度。陳方守軍，《陳書》與《資治通鑑》所載自數萬至數十萬不等，亦難核實。距離方面，廣陵至采石約一百五十里，采石至建康水路約二百餘里，隋軍自廣陵出發到夜渡采石約歷數日。時間方面，開皇八年（588）冬主力出兵，開皇九年（589）正月渡江，正月克建康、陳朝覆亡；其後開皇九年冬至十年初，楊素等平定江南反亂。舟艦方面，《隋書·楊素傳》記其督造大艦、備攻城器械，五牙大艦與黃龍艦成列，隋軍舟船總數以數百計，遠程則以強弩與蹶張弩為主力。區域方面，嶺南經冼夫人協助歸附，隋的統治範圍自此南抵南海。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and only what the histories record explicitly is given here. On strength, the History of Sui, Annals of the Founder, records that in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang the Emperor mass-mobilised the army, and later writers commonly speak of the Sui force as numbering more than half a million men; that figure plainly includes camp followers, labour used to move grain and conscripted service personnel, and the number of troops actually in armour and in line was far smaller, a point on which the historians of the day are generally cautious. The size of the Chen army is given in the History of Chen and the Comprehensive Mirror in Figures as ranging from several tens of thousands to several hundred thousand, and cannot be checked. On distance, Guangling lies about 150 li from Caishi, and the water route from Caishi to Jiankang is about 200 li and more, while the Sui advance from Guangling to the night crossing at Caishi took a number of days. On time, the main columns mustered in the winter of 588, crossed the river in the first month of 589, took Jiankang in that same month, and Chen ceased to exist; the risings in Jiangnan were then put down between the winter of 589 and the beginning of the following year. On shipping, the History of Sui, biography of Yang Su, records his supervision of the great ships and the preparation of siege engines, with the five-pronged great ships and yellow dragon ships in line, the river craft of the Sui running to several hundred, while the main missile weapons were the strong crossbow and the pedal-drawn crossbow. In terms of territory, Lingnan was brought in with the help of Lady Xian, and Sui rule reached south to the South Sea.
cause: 打起嚟嘅根由，一半係統一，一半係形勢。隋文帝代周之後，北方已定，卻仍有半壁江山在陳朝手上；文帝志在混一天下，南征之議屢發，只是北邊突厥壓境、國內儲備未足而屢屢推延。開皇八年，隋已平高句麗、收納陳朝降戶，倉廩充盈，民間租調有餘，兵源與糧源同時到位，於是下詔大發兵平陳。謀劃出自高熲，他獻的平陳十策，核心是先取荊州、斷陳之上游，以蜀道輸糧，再以大軍直趨建康，可避開正面強攻。陳朝自身的困局也加速了崩解：後主沉溺聲色，寵信佞臣，朝廷上下只知宴樂，軍備雖強而將令不一；江南士族對隋既觀望又不肯出力，蕭摩訶等宿將屢請出戰而不得用。隋方則利用陳朝內部空隙，以夜渡奇襲打亂其部署，最終把戰爭變成一次建康城下的總決戰。
causeEn: The reasons for the war are half a matter of unification and half a matter of circumstance. After replacing the Zhou, the Sui had settled the north, yet half the realm was still held by the Chen court; the emperor's ambition was to unite the empire, and proposals for a southern campaign were raised again and again, but were repeatedly deferred because of the pressure of the Turks in the north and the insufficiency of reserves at home. In the eighth year of Kaihuang, having subdued Goguryeo and taken over the Chen households who had fled north, the Sui had full granaries, tax and rent in surplus, and men and grain in the same ample supply, and so the edict for mass mobilisation went out. The planning came from Gao Jiong, whose ten strategies for pacifying Chen held that Jingzhou should be taken first to cut Chen off from its upper reaches, that supplies should be moved through the Shu route, and that the main army should then strike at Jiankang, thereby avoiding a frontal assault. Chen's own internal collapse hastened the end: the last emperor was absorbed in music and women, favoured flatterers, and the court at large knew only feasting, so that although the arms were strong the orders were contradictory; Jiangnan scholars watched and waited and would not commit themselves, and veterans such as Xiao Mohe repeatedly asked to be employed and were refused. The Sui exploited these divisions and used a night crossing to disrupt the Chen deployment, turning the war in the end into a single decisive battle beneath the walls of Jiankang.
impact: 此役之後，南北分裂局面結束。自西晉永嘉之亂以來近二百七十年的分裂，隨陳朝覆亡而告終，隋成為中國自秦漢之後第一個重新統一南北的王朝，結束了自東晉以來南朝偏安的格局。這對後世影響至深：其一，隋朝以州縣制重新編制江南，罷除陳朝部分苛政，減租調、輕徭役，江南士族在隋初獲得相對寬鬆的環境，社會生產得以恢復；其二，隋文帝整飭律令，開皇律成為唐律的基礎，制度一體化自此展開；其三，陳亡時大批南朝文物與樂舞被運往長安，陳後主的《玉樹後庭花》與宮中舊樂後來反被隋煬帝所賞玩，演成歷史上「亡國之音」的典故，成為文人論治失國的常用譬喻；其四，統一大業完成後，隋文帝轉入休養，開皇年間倉廩充盈、百姓安堵，國力反而進一步上升，但全國性的兵役動員與江南新附之地一同被納入王朝控制，也埋下日後大興東征、濫用民力的種子。
impactEn: After this campaign the division of the country into north and south came to an end. The nearly two hundred and seventy years of separation that had run since the Yongjia disaster of the Western Jin ended with the fall of Chen; the Sui became the first dynasty since Qin and Han to reunite north and south, closing the pattern of a southern dynasty holding only the south in passive balance that had obtained since the Eastern Jin. The consequences reached far into the future. First, the Sui rebuilt the Jiangnan administration on the commandery and county system, abolished part of the harsher Chen measures, reduced land tax and corvée, and the Jiangnan elite enjoyed a relatively lenient environment in the early Sui, so that production could recover. Second, the emperor tightened the statutes, and the Kaihuang Code became the basis of the Tang Code, so that institutional unification began here. Third, when Chen fell, a great quantity of Southern court objects, music and dance was carried north to Chang'an; the last emperor's Yu-shu Hou-ting-hua and the old music of his palace were later enjoyed by Emperor Yang of Sui, and turned into the historical set phrase for the music of a lost state, a stock image used by writers when they speak of a state undone by excess. Fourth, once unification was complete, Emperor Wen turned to recuperation; the granaries filled and the people were at ease in the Kaihuang years, and the state's strength rose still further, but at the same time nationwide conscription and the newly submitted south were both folded into the control of the dynasty, which planted the seed of the later mobilisation of masses for the eastern campaigns.
result: 結果是隋軍全勝，陳朝滅亡。開皇九年正月，隋軍渡江、破采石與姑孰，進克石頭城與建康；後主陳叔寶與張麗華、孔貴嬪躲入景陽殿井中，被隋軍以繩索拉出，陳氏宗室、百官與宮人隨之被擄，陳朝三十七年的統治告終。陳將蕭摩訶、任忠等或戰或降，任忠等降後仍被處死，陳朝舊將被整肅，江南原有的軍事勢力隨之拆除。隋朝隨即在江南改置州郡、派官鎮守，開皇九年冬至十年初楊素等平定江南反亂，嶺南亦經冼夫人率部眾協助歸附，天下一統由制度上完成。建康仍為南方重鎮，但城內的宮殿、府庫與文物被隋軍大批運往長安，陳叔寶受封鄭王、移居洛陽，陳樂與陳舞被收進隋宮，從此南朝作為獨立王朝的歷史在文獻中終結。
resultEn: The result was a complete Sui victory and the destruction of the Chen state. In the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui army crossed the river, broke through at Caishi and Gushu, and took the Stone City and Jiankang; the last emperor, Chen Shubao, hid with Zhang Lihua and Kong Guifei in a well in the Jingyang Hall and was pulled out on a rope by Sui soldiers, and the Chen clan, the ministers and the palace folk were carried off with him, ending the thirty-seven years of Chen rule. Chen commanders such as Xiao Mohe and Ren Zhong were killed or surrendered; Ren Zhong was executed even after surrendering, the former Chen officers were purged, and the military power of the old southern regime was dismantled. The Sui immediately replaced the Chen administration in the south with commanderies and counties and posted its own officials, put down the risings in Jiangnan between the winter of the ninth year of Kaihuang and the beginning of the next, and, with the clansmen of Lady Xian helping, brought Lingnan to terms, so that unity was completed not only on the ground but in institutions. Jiankang remained a southern centre, but its palaces, treasuries and objects were carried off in bulk to Chang'an; Chen Shubao was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng and moved to Luoyang, and the music and dance of Chen were taken into the Sui palace, and with that the history of the Southern dynasties as independent regimes ends in the record.
